# 设计-开发交付

## 概述

本章聚焦设计与开发之间的交付协作，分为设计交付流程、设计规范沟通、反馈与迭代、协作工具四个部分。它提供交付环节常用的英语词汇，覆盖从移交设计稿到沟通规范再到迭代修正的过程。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合跨角色沟通和交付文档。建议把交付流程与规范沟通类词汇结合学习，减少交付中的理解偏差。

## 设计交付流程

| 词汇        | 词性 | 含义 | 常用搭配                                |
| ----------- | ---- | ---- | --------------------------------------- |
| handoff     | n.   | 交付 | design handoff, developer handoff       |
| redline     | n.   | 标注 | redline specs, pixel-perfect redline    |
| annotation  | n.   | 注释 | design annotation, add annotations      |
| asset       | n.   | 素材 | export assets, image assets             |
| spec        | n.   | 规格 | design spec, spacing spec               |
| walkthrough | n.   | 讲解 | design walkthrough, walkthrough session |

### 听说例句

> A: When is the design handoff scheduled? B: Thursday at 2 PM. I'll do a walkthrough of the specs and share all exported assets.

> A: Are the redlines accurate for this component? B: Yes, I've added annotations for every spacing value and color token.

### 写作表达

- A structured design handoff process with detailed redlines minimizes implementation errors and revision cycles.
- All design assets should be exported and organized before the walkthrough session with the development team.

---

## 设计规范沟通

| 词汇              | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                                     |
| ----------------- | ---- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| design token      | n.   | 设计令牌 | color tokens, spacing tokens                 |
| component library | n.   | 组件库   | shared component library, update library     |
| breakpoint        | n.   | 断点     | responsive breakpoint, breakpoint definition |
| padding           | n.   | 内边距   | consistent padding, padding values           |
| margin            | n.   | 外边距   | margin spacing, auto margin                  |
| typography        | n.   | 排版     | typography scale, font hierarchy             |

### 听说例句

> A: Which design tokens should I use for this card component? B: Use the primary color token and 16px padding. The typography scale follows our global font hierarchy.

> A: What are the breakpoints for the responsive layout? B: 375px for mobile, 768px for tablet, and 1280px for desktop. They're documented in the component library.

### 写作表达

- Design tokens serve as the single source of truth for colors, spacing, and typography across all platforms.
- Clearly defined breakpoints in the component library ensure consistent responsive behavior.

---

## 反馈与迭代

| 词汇           | 词性 | 含义       | 常用搭配                                          |
| -------------- | ---- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| pixel-perfect  | adj. | 像素级精确 | pixel-perfect implementation, pixel-perfect match |
| deviation      | n.   | 偏差       | design deviation, report deviation                |
| revision       | n.   | 修改版     | design revision, revision round                   |
| iteration      | n.   | 迭代       | design iteration, quick iteration                 |
| QA (design QA) | n.   | 设计质检   | design QA pass, visual QA                         |
| sign-off       | n.   | 签收       | design sign-off, get approval                     |

### 听说例句

> A: The implementation has a few pixel deviations from the mockup. B: Let me check. I'll flag the deviations and do a design QA pass before sign-off.

> A: How many revision rounds do we typically need? B: Usually two. After the first iteration, we get design sign-off and move to QA.

### 写作表达

- Design QA ensures pixel-perfect implementation by systematically comparing the build against the approved mockups.
- Limiting revision rounds to two iterations per feature helps maintain velocity without sacrificing visual quality.

---

## 协作工具

| 词汇      | 词性 | 含义      | 常用搭配                            |
| --------- | ---- | --------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Figma     | n.   | Figma     | design in Figma, Figma file         |
| Zeplin    | n.   | Zeplin    | export to Zeplin, Zeplin specs      |
| Storybook | n.   | Storybook | component Storybook, visual testing |
| inspect   | v.   | 检查      | inspect mode, inspect design        |
| embed     | v.   | 嵌入      | embed preview, embed in docs        |
| plugin    | n.   | 插件      | Figma plugin, design plugin         |

### 听说例句

> A: Should we use Figma inspect mode or export to Zeplin? B: Figma inspect is fine for most cases. We'll use Storybook for component-level visual testing.

> A: Can you embed the design preview in the ticket? B: Sure, I'll add the Figma embed link so devs can inspect the latest version directly.

### 写作表达

- Figma inspect mode and Zeplin complement each other by providing both interactive exploration and static specification views.
- Storybook serves as a living documentation platform where implemented components can be visually verified against design specs.
